findings.title: Target Connection Failure
findings.description: Failed to establish connection to target URL: Connection failed or DNS lookup error: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='testasp.vulnweb.com', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: / (Caused by NewConnectionError('<urllib3.connection.HTTPSConnection object at 0x7fbd2ec2f0e0>: Failed to establish a new connection: [Errno 101] Network is unreachable'))
findings.remediation: Verify target host reachability, DNS configuration, and active listening services.
